mapper.sql: id, user_id, department_id, full_name, qualification, specialization, registration_number, experience_years, phone, email, about, consultation_fee, daily_limit, is_active, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctors (department_id, full_name, qualification, specialization, registration_number, experience_years, phone, email, about, consultation_fee, daily_limit, is_active, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{fullName}, #{qualification}, #{specialization}, #{registrationNumber}, #{experienceYears}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{about}, #{consultationFee}, #{dailyLimit}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctors SET is_active = #{active}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_availability (doctor_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT appointment_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS booked FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND appointment_date >= CURDATE() AND status = 'BOOKED' GROUP BY appointment_date

SELECT a.token_number AS tokenNumber, u.full_name AS patientName, p.patient_code AS patientCode, a.reporting_time AS reportingTime, a.status AS status FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.appointment_date = #{date} ORDER BY a.token_number
